from playwright.sync_api import Page
from pages.base_page_object import BasePageObject


class HomePage(BasePageObject):
    """Page object for the application home page."""

    def __init__(self, page: Page) -> None:
        """
        Initialize the HomePage object.

        Args:
            page: Playwright Page instance
        """
        super().__init__(page)
        
        # Locators
        self.home_page_container = page.locator('[data-testid="home-page"]')
        self.register_button = page.locator('[data-testid="register-button"]')

    def navigate_to_home_page(self, base_url: str) -> None:
        """
        Navigate to the application home page and verify page load.

        Args:
            base_url: Base URL of the application
        """
        self.page.goto(base_url)
        self.page.wait_for_load_state("domcontentloaded")
        self.wait_for_element_visible(self.home_page_container, timeout=30000)

    def click_register_button(self) -> None:
        """
        Click the register button and wait for registration page to load.
        """
        self.register_button.click()
        self.page.wait_for_load_state("domcontentloaded")

code.implementation:
from playwright.sync_api import Page
from pages.base_page_object import BasePageObject


class RegistrationPage(BasePageObject):
    """Page object for the user registration page."""

    def __init__(self, page: Page) -> None:
        """
        Initialize the RegistrationPage object.

        Args:
            page: Playwright Page instance
        """
        super().__init__(page)
        
        # Locators
        self.registration_form = page.locator('[data-testid="registration-form"]')
        self.username_input = page.locator('[data-testid="username-input"]')
        self.email_input = page.locator('[data-testid="email-input"]')
        self.password_input = page.locator('[data-testid="password-input"]')
        self.confirm_password_input = page.locator('[data-testid="confirm-password-input"]')
        self.first_name_input = page.locator('[data-testid="first-name-input"]')
        self.last_name_input = page.locator('[data-testid="last-name-input"]')
        self.submit_button = page.locator('[data-testid="submit-button"]')

    def enter_username(self, username: str) -> None:
        """
        Enter username in the username input field.

        Args:
            username: Username to enter
        """
        self.wait_for_element_visible(self.username_input, timeout=10000)
        self.username_input.clear()
        self.username_input.fill(username)

    def enter_email(self, email: str) -> None:
        """
        Enter email in the email input field.

        Args:
            email: Email address to enter
        """
        self.wait_for_element_visible(self.email_input, timeout=10000)
        self.email_input.clear()
        self.email_input.fill(email)

    def enter_password(self, password: str) -> None:
        """
        Enter password in the password input field.

        Args:
            password: Password to enter
        """
        self.wait_for_element_visible(self.password_input, timeout=10000)
        self.password_input.clear()
        self.password_input.fill(password)

    def enter_confirm_password(self, confirm_password: str) -> None:
        """
        Enter confirm password in the confirm password input field.

        Args:
            confirm_password: Confirm password to enter
        """
        self.wait_for_element_visible(self.confirm_password_input, timeout=10000)
        self.confirm_password_input.clear()
        self.confirm_password_input.fill(confirm_password)

    def enter_first_name(self, first_name: str) -> None:
        """
        Enter first name in the first name input field.

        Args:
            first_name: First name to enter
        """
        self.wait_for_element_visible(self.first_name_input, timeout=10000)
        self.first_name_input.clear()
        self.first_name_input.fill(first_name)

    def enter_last_name(self, last_name: str) -> None:
        """
        Enter last name in the last name input field.

        Args:
            last_name: Last name to enter
        """
        self.wait_for_element_visible(self.last_name_input, timeout=10000)
        self.last_name_input.clear()
        self.last_name_input.fill(last_name)

    def click_submit_button(self) -> None:
        """
        Click the submit button and wait for form submission to complete.
        """
        self.submit_button.click()
        self.page.wait_for_load_state("domcontentloaded")

    def fill_registration_form(self, username: str, email: str, password: str, 
                               confirm_password: str, first_name: str, last_name: str) -> None:
        """
        Fill all registration form fields with provided data.

        Args:
            username: Username to enter
            email: Email address to enter
            password: Password to enter
            confirm_password: Confirm password to enter
            first_name: First name to enter
            last_name: Last name to enter
        """
        self.enter_username(username)
        self.enter_email(email)
        self.enter_password(password)
        self.enter_confirm_password(confirm_password)
        self.enter_first_name(first_name)
        self.enter_last_name(last_name)

from playwright.sync_api import Page
from pages.base_page_object import BasePageObject


class RegistrationConfirmationPage(BasePageObject):
    """Page object for the registration confirmation/success page."""

    def __init__(self, page: Page) -> None:
        """
        Initialize the RegistrationConfirmationPage object.

        Args:
            page: Playwright Page instance
        """
        super().__init__(page)
        
        # Locators
        self.success_message = page.locator('[data-testid="success-message"]')

    def verify_success_message_visible(self) -> bool:
        """
        Verify success message is visible on the page.

        Returns:
            bool: True if success message is visible, False otherwise
        """
        try:
            self.wait_for_element_visible(self.success_message, timeout=30000)
            return self.success_message.is_visible()
        except Exception:
            return False

    def verify_success_message_text(self, expected_message: str = "Registration successful") -> bool:
        """
        Verify success message displays expected text.

        Args:
            expected_message: Expected success message text (default: 'Registration successful')

        Returns:
            bool: True if message text matches expected, False otherwise
        """
        try:
            self.wait_for_element_visible(self.success_message, timeout=30000)
            actual_text = self.success_message.text_content().strip()
            return expected_message.lower() in actual_text.lower()
        except Exception:
            return False

    def get_success_message_text(self) -> str:
        """
        Get the text content of the success message.

        Returns:
            str: Success message text content
        """
        self.wait_for_element_visible(self.success_message, timeout=30000)
        return self.success_message.text_content().strip()
